{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Amber Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Amber Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= [[Amber]], a Gem |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |location= |uses= Enhancing [[Armor]] |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Gems''', also known as '''Gemstones''' or '''Jewels''', are a recurring class of [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Gem|Gems|Series, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} |- | '''Gemstone''' | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} |- | '''Jewel''' | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{List| * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gems are valuable [[Material]]s that can be used to [[Enhancing|Enhance]] [[Armor]], craft new gear, or be sold at a high price to shops and merchants. Gems are generally found by breaking [[Ore Deposit]]s, with [[Rare Ore Deposit]]s more likely to yield rarer varieties. Gems can also sometimes be found inside [[Treasure Chest]]s, as well as dropped by [[Stone Talus]]es, [[Stone Pebblit]]s, and [[Silver Bokoblin|Silver]] and [[Golden Bokoblin|Golden]] [[Enemy|Enemies]]. After [[Pelison]] moves to [[Tarrey Town]], he will open [[Ore and More]], a [[Jewelry Shop]] that sells a few Gems at a high price. Gems are most notably used to purchase and craft [[Accessory|Accessories]] at [[Starlight Memories]] in [[Gerudo Town]]. The respective Gem is also used to Enhance these Accessories as well. After completing the [[Side Quest]] "[[The Jewel Trade]]", [[Ramella]] will offer to buy ten pieces of a randomly chosen Gem at a higher price than at stores. ====List of Gems==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |columns= Material [Image][Link], Description [Transcript], Value [Rupees], Additional uses [List:plain] |- | Amber | A fossilized resin with a caramelesque sheen to it.
